title: PQC-E0: Post-Quantum Readiness Report — SQUIRL OS Alignment with Executive Order 14412 / M-26-15 (Battery Re-Verification Zero Drift, Gaps Disclosed)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. Not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic.

PQC-E0 — Post-Quantum Readiness Report against Executive Order 14412 (June 22, 2026, "Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks") and OMB memo M-26-15. The EO binds federal agencies to post-quantum encryption by Dec 31, 2030 and post-quantum authentication by Dec 31, 2031, with federal contractors held to post-quantum FIPS compliance by end of 2030. This report maps the SQUIRL OS prototype stack against that mandate on the night the posture was re-verified.

Posture (receipted): frozen PQC allowlist (CRYSTALS-Dilithium3 / ML-DSA-65, kyber_1024 / ML-KEM-1024, SPHINCS+-256f / SLH-DSA family — all NIST FIPS 203/204/205 families), enforced by deterministic gates with no LLM in the decision path. Re-verified the same night: HACK-17 CNSA 2.0 timeline-conformance battery 6/6 PASS and HACK-18 FIPS 140-3 module-integrity battery 6/6 PASS — both receipts BYTE-IDENTICAL to their frozen baselines (26d198fe...87c66 and 44c72afd...61d17; zero drift, deterministic re-runs). Operational discipline: pre-rotation pqcManager validation, weekly PQC Day audits, live quantum-threat anomaly detection with SIP-gated migration, and — deployed the same evening on the owner's GO — a deterministic PQC migration playbook for the quantum_vulnerability_detected fixture class, already 2-for-2 on real held probes (41s and 43s heals, allowlist-only, zero classical fallback).

Honest gaps (stated, not hidden): (1) No FIPS 140-3 validated modules — PQC implementations are software-scoped; adoption path is validated-module integration when CMVP-listed PQC modules mature, not a premature lab engagement. (2) CNSA 2.0's ML-DSA-87 preference vs the frozen ML-DSA-65 allowlist — a SIP-gated review item, never auto-changed. (3) Public anchor rails (BTC ECDSA secp256k1, Stellar/XRP Ed25519) are classically signed; mitigation posture is hash-linked SHA-256 receipt chains plus tri-chain redundancy. (4) No federal contractor status (no SAM.gov/UEI/CAGE). No federal authorization, FIPS validation, or certification is claimed.
